dct_description_sm:
Leaf area index (LAI) quantified the density of vegetation irrespective of land cover.  LAI quantifies the total foliage surface area per ground surface area.  LAI has been identified by the Global Climate Observing System as an essential climate variable required for ecosystem, weather and climate modelling and monitoring.  This product consists of a national scale coverage (Canada) of monthly maps of the maximum LAI during a growing season (May-June-july-August-September)  at 20m.  
  
  References:
